official.description: TOP200 NAWA is a new NAWA initiative aimed at supporting transnational science cooperation and fostering excellent research in Poland by attracting outstanding research talents from universities ranked 1 to 200 in global rankings. It provides stable employment for two to four years at Polish universities or research institutes, with the possibility of setting up own research teams.
official.program_type: Research employment programme attracting global research talent to Poland

verification.notes: Read directly on NAWA's own programme page. applicant_utility.summary: This is a job, not a grant: NAWA funds a call budget of PLN 17 million in total and the host institution gives you a full-time employment contract, so your actual salary is negotiated with the host rather than set by NAWA. That makes finding the right host the real work - NAWA itself points applicants at researchinpoland.org for exactly that reason. Because the pilot round closed on 27 February 2026 with results due by 31 July 2026, there is currently nothing to apply for; treat this as background for the next call and use the interval to build a host relationship.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Early-career researchers (doctorate within the last seven years) and established team leaders currently at a top-200 global university who want a funded research group in Poland.
application_readiness_checklist: Work out which track you fit - Junior Fellow if your doctorate is no more than seven years old at the deadline, Senior Fellow if you have led research teams - because the evidence you prepare differs sharply
Confirm your current institution appears in the Shanghai, QS or THE top 200 in a current edition, since NAWA names all three rankings as qualifying
Start conversations with prospective Polish hosts early and use researchinpoland.org, NAWA's recommended platform, to find a supervisor
Negotiate the employment package with the host directly: NAWA publishes a call budget, not a salary scale
Register for the NAWA applicant portal at programs.nawa.gov.pl and check the Call for applications and Documents pages when a new round opens
common_rejection_risks: Assuming NAWA pays you directly - the money flows through the host's employment contract, so a weak host commitment sinks the application
Applying to the wrong track for your career stage, particularly Senior Fellow applicants without documented team-leadership experience
Relying on a ranking position from an older edition when your institution has dropped out of the top 200
Looking for a salary figure on NAWA's site and finding only the PLN 17 million total call budget, then misjudging the offer
Missing that the published pilot round has already closed and waiting for a portal that has no open call
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Not published. NAWA publishes only the total call budget of PLN 17 million, so relocation, family and any costs outside the host employment contract must be negotiated case by case with the host institution.
document_audit: NAWA's 'Call for applications' sub-page carries no published content, so the document list must come from the 'Dokumenty do pobrania' (Documents to download) section when a round opens
You will need proof of your doctorate date for the Junior Fellow seven-year test - the clock runs to the application deadline, not to the start of employment
Evidence of research-team leadership is needed for Senior Fellow and is not something you can assemble at the last minute
alerts: The published pilot round closed on 27 February 2026, with evaluation results due by 31 July 2026 - there is no open application right now
The programme is framed as a pilot with a 2026-2032 implementation window, so future rounds are not guaranteed on the published timetable
Access to research infrastructure, administrative support and integration help is described as support from the host institution, not as a NAWA entitlement - get it written into your host agreement
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Secure a host institution and supervisor, then submit through the NAWA applicant portal at programs.nawa.gov.pl when a call is open.
